comments.author: askhl
comments.body:
In principle we should have an ase-maintainers list since neither the committee nor users are quite the group of maintainers.  But let's just merge...

Thanks :smile:

thread.actionability_reasoning: This is a meta-discussion comment about process (creating a mailing list) that the author themselves dismisses by saying 'let's just merge.' It is primarily a social/acknowledgment comment with no concrete requested code change.
